# Generation of representative threshold data

```{r}
threshold_cluster_summary <- threshold_profiles %>%
  mutate(across(-genome_id, as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -genome_id,
    names_to = "threshold",
    values_to = "profile"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    threshold = as.integer(threshold),
    aa_cluster = sub("[.].*$", "", profile)
  ) %>%
  count(threshold, aa_cluster, name = "cluster_size") %>%
  group_by(threshold) %>%
  summarise(
    multi_genome_clusters = sum(cluster_size > 1),
    genomes_in_multi_genome_clusters = sum(cluster_size[cluster_size > 1]),
    singleton_groups = sum(cluster_size == 1),
    total_aa_groups = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

aa_group_sizes <- profile_assignments %>%
  count(aa_cluster, name = "group_size") %>%
  transmute(grouping = "350-AA groups", group_size)

partitioned_group_sizes <- profile_assignments %>%
  count(profile, name = "group_size") %>%
  transmute(grouping = "Genotype- and resistance-partitioned groups", group_size)

group_size_summary <- bind_rows(
  aa_group_sizes,
  partitioned_group_sizes
) %>%
  group_by(grouping) %>%
  summarise(
    groups = n(),
    singleton_groups = sum(group_size == 1),
    multi_genome_groups = sum(group_size > 1),
    singleton_isolates = sum(group_size[group_size == 1]),
    multi_genome_isolates = sum(group_size[group_size > 1]),
    median_size = median(group_size),
    size_q1 = unname(quantile(group_size, 0.25)),
    size_q3 = unname(quantile(group_size, 0.75)),
    maximum_size = max(group_size),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

paste0("Number of genomes assigned to amino acid clusters: ",nrow(profile_assignments))

paste0("First AA threshold where every group is in a multi-genome cluster: ")
threshold_cluster_summary %>% filter(singleton_groups == 0) %>% slice_min(threshold, n = 1) %>% favorite_kable()

paste0("AA-based clustering data at 350 AA threshold")
group_size_summary %>% favorite_kable()
```
